lc_01.EN: Matheesha Pathirana bowls Suryakumar Yadav with a yorker (+25 wicket, +8 bowled bonus = +33 pts)!
lc_01.HI: Matheesha Pathirana ne Suryakumar Yadav ko yorker par bowled kiya (+33 pts)!

lc_02.EN: Tim David is out LBW for 0 (-2 duck penalty). Pathirana earns another wicket (+33 pts).
lc_02.HI: Tim David 0 par LBW out huye (-2 duck penalty). Pathirana ko mile aur +33 pts.

lc_03.EN: Romario Shepherd negotiates the hat-trick ball safely. Dot ball.
lc_03.HI: Romario Shepherd ne hat-trick ball safely kheli. Dot ball.

lc_04.EN: Ravindra Jadeja runs out Hardik Pandya with a direct hit (+12 pts fielding bonus)!
lc_04.HI: Ravindra Jadeja ne direct hit se Hardik Pandya ko run out kiya (+12 pts)!

lc_05.EN: Piyush Chawla edges behind to MS Dhoni (+8 catch). MI lose 4 wickets in 7 balls!
lc_05.HI: Piyush Chawla out huye, MS Dhoni ne catch pakda (+8 pts). MI ke 4 wickets gire!
